name: presentationkit
description: Manifest-driven presentation generation toolkit for evidence-first technical stories.
author: Matt Jensen

scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js validate examples/operational-ai-support.deck.json
scripts.plan:example: node dist/cli.js plan examples/operational-ai-support.deck.json --out dist/plan --diagrams dist/diagrams --deck-out dist/operational-ai-support.pptx
scripts.build:example: node dist/cli.js build examples/operational-ai-support.deck.json --out dist/operational-ai-support.pptx --diagrams dist/diagrams --manifest-out dist/render-manifest.json --plan-out dist/plan --qa-out dist/qa --deterministic
scripts.smoke: npm run check && npm run validate:examples && npm run inspect:example && npm run list:intents && npm run plan:example && npm run preflight:example && npm run qa:example && npm run render:example && npm run build:example
